commit.message: Organize bundled Rust resources under asset directories (#41477)

scope.request_http_headers: Codex-explicit + auth/provider/request-preparation headers. Runtime transport-generated values are not guessed.
scope.response_http_headers: Headers statically consumed by Codex response/error parsers. Parser support is not evidence that production currently emits each header.

notes: The backend status client builds its own HeaderMap; originator is not part of that builder.
ChatGPT Cloudflare cookies can be attached by the transport at runtime.

http_headers.name: originator
http_headers.condition: default process originator; may be thread-overridden

http_headers.name: x-codex-turn-metadata
http_headers.condition: request_kind present; compatibility projection omits tool_namespaces_info

http_headers.name: x-codex-routing-hint
http_headers.condition: Codex backend routing hint when available

http_headers.name: x-oai-attestation
http_headers.condition: when attestation is enabled/provider returns value

http_headers.name: x-codex-turn-state
http_headers.condition: replayed within the same turn after server supplies it

turn_metadata.compatibility_header: x-codex-turn-metadata; tool_namespaces_info removed from bounded header projection

handshake_http_headers.name: originator
handshake_http_headers.condition: default process originator; may be thread-overridden

handshake_http_headers.name: x-codex-turn-metadata
handshake_http_headers.condition: request_kind present; compatibility projection omits tool_namespaces_info

handshake_http_headers.name: x-codex-routing-hint
handshake_http_headers.condition: Codex backend routing hint when available

handshake_http_headers.name: x-oai-attestation
handshake_http_headers.condition: when attestation is enabled/provider returns value

turn_metadata.compatibility_handshake_header: x-codex-turn-metadata can be in upgrade compatibility headers; tool_namespaces_info omitted there

notes: x-codex-turn-state is carried in response.create client_metadata for per-message WS continuation state.
Connection/Upgrade/Sec-WebSocket-* are generated by the WebSocket stack, not hard-coded protocol identity fields.

response_headers.evidence: client_parser_schema; not proof of production server emission

exact_headers.name: x-reasoning-included
exact_headers.condition: successful Responses/SSE or WS handshake metadata

exact_headers.name: x-codex-turn-state
exact_headers.condition: successful Responses/SSE or WS continuation state

exact_headers.name: x-request-id
exact_headers.condition: upstream request tracking and retry errors

exact_headers.name: x-codex-active-limit
exact_headers.condition: 429 usage_limit_reached selects the active quota family

exact_headers.name: x-oai-request-id
exact_headers.condition: fallback upstream request tracking on errors

exact_headers.name: cf-ray
exact_headers.condition: fallback request tracking and unexpected-status diagnostics

dynamic_header_patterns.name: x-<limit-id>-primary-used-percent
dynamic_header_patterns.condition: discovers and parses a metered quota family

dynamic_header_patterns.name: x-<limit-id>-limit-name
dynamic_header_patterns.condition: display name for a dynamically discovered quota family

websocket_events.effect: converted to the same RateLimitSnapshot used by HTTP response headers

notes: Fields are conditional/optional according to request kind and available context.
serde(flatten) extra fields serialize at the same JSON object level; there is no wire-level extra wrapper.
Memory request_kind suppresses normal turn/request identity according to has_turn_identity().
